name: gh-identity-router
description: Multi-account GitHub App/PAT credential routing by target repository owner, shared by any coding-agent identity that needs to act as a different login per organization

scripts.test: node --test && bash test/identity.test.sh && bash bin/identity.sh --self-check && bash -c 'find . -name "*.sh" -not -path "./node_modules/*" -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 bash -n' && node scripts/scrub-check.mjs
